summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a US$25 million private placement of special warrants. The offering involves 5,828,342 special warrants at US$4.25 each, each automatically converting into one common share and one warrant (exercise price US$5.00, five-year term). Net proceeds will repay debt, fund product development, potential acquisitions, and working capital. Clear Street LLC serves as exclusive placement agent. The securities are offered under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) of the Securities Act, with a registration rights agreement for resale. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
